title: Minimize Malware Spread
goal: Choose one initial infection to clear so the final malware spread is smallest.
strategy: The graph remains intact. A connected component is saved only when it has exactly one initially infected node and that node is cleared. Maximize the saved component size, breaking ties by the smallest node index.
